selected_evidence.requirement: Persistent host firewall configured on node1 (SSH open, port 9000 scoped to node2 only, rejected elsewhere)
selected_evidence.summary: ufw enabled with default deny incoming; rule set shows 22/tcp allow anywhere, 9000/tcp allow only from 10.100.49.11 (node2), 9000/tcp reject from anywhere else, for both IPv4 and IPv6, with firewall reported active and enabled on startup

selected_evidence.requirement: Functional proof: node2 can reach 9000, node3 and general traffic are rejected, SSH remains open to all
selected_evidence.summary: Live nc listener on node1:9000; node2 nc -zv succeeded on 9000 and 22; node3 nc -zv on 9000 returned connection refused while 22 succeeded

selected_evidence.requirement: Pre-restart healthy baseline on node1 (boot id + firewall state)
selected_evidence.summary: Captured node1 boot_id c0691b74... and full active ufw ruleset before restart

selected_evidence.requirement: Pre-restart healthy baseline on node2 and node3 (boot id)
selected_evidence.summary: Captured node2 boot_id 17b362d1... and node3 boot_id b19a635d... before their restarts

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Reboot acknowledged and returned before disconnect; subsequent polls failed (unreachable) then succeeded with new boot_id 0f65abd0...; ufw ruleset confirmed intact post-reboot; live functional retest showed node2 allowed and node3 rejected on port 9000, matching pre-restart behavior

selected_evidence.requirement: node2 restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Reboot acknowledged; polls failed then succeeded with new boot_id 7e640741...; node2->node1:9000 connectivity re-verified successful after node2's own restart

selected_evidence.requirement: node3 restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Reboot acknowledged; polls failed then succeeded with new boot_id 960a28a3... (was b19a635d...); post-reboot test confirmed node3->node1:9000 still rejected and SSH still reachable, matching required firewall policy

selected_evidence.requirement: Cleanup of test artifacts, final firewall state confirmation
selected_evidence.summary: Test nc listener killed on node1; final ufw status verbose shows the same persistent rule set active after all three node restarts
